fractions: Choose this pack’s grade, then Fractions of quantities.
Model a known part and recover the whole.
money: Choose this pack’s grade, then Money & decisions.
measurement: Choose this pack’s grade, then Area & perimeter.
percent: Choose percentage-of-quantity and reverse-percentage activities; avoid secondary extensions.
Show the reference whole before finding a percentage or recovering the whole.
ratio: Choose simple sharing and equivalent-ratio questions.
Use equal units to show shares and differences.
sets: Use common number-type classification only; listing members of specific finite sets remains in the pack.
Use the two-set Venn diagram for common and combined members.
whole-operations: Choose suitable whole-number multiplication, division and inverse operations.
fraction-operations: Select like denominators for Grade 4; unlike denominators and products for Grade 5; include division for Grade 6.
decimals: Choose place value, ordering or arithmetic at the appropriate level.
units: Use metric and time activities; for Grade 6 choose area-unit conversions. Omit imperial and radian activities.
time: Use Clock Face to explain readings and elapsed time; the pack also includes tasks beyond this 12-hour display.
Select time conversions. The full timetable problems remain on the paper.
area-shapes: Select simple rectangular area, perimeter and missing-side questions.
Use blank grids and polygon outlines to build the pack’s diagrams.
angles-lines: Select basic angles on lines; use a physical protractor for measuring and drawing tasks.
Use line and shape outlines for angle and line-property discussions.
position: Choose simple slides and reflections on a suitable grid; omit matrix transformations and secondary extensions.
solids: Choose 3D Solids: cubes and cuboids in Grade 4, pyramids in Grade 5, prisms in Grade 6. Use the printed nets alongside them.
patterns: Choose simple number-pattern activities and tables; omit quadratic and advanced nth-term questions.
expressions: Choose the simplest one- and two-variable substitutions and formulae.
equations: Develop missing-number and simple equation reasoning visually.
Select one-step or straightforward two-step questions only.
graphs: Use blank grids and frequency tables to draw the pack’s data displays. This is a drawing template, not a graph-question generator.
probability: Use the blank tree diagram to list simple coin outcomes. The written chance questions remain in the pack.
place-value: Choose Place Value Chart; extend the discussion to the larger numbers printed in the pack.
fraction-comparison: Use Fraction Bars with the same reference whole.
temperature: Practise simple addition, subtraction and temperature differences; use a number line alongside the tool. It does not display a thermometer.
plane-shapes: Choose basic shape properties; keep the focus on triangles and quadrilaterals.
Choose 2D Shapes to discuss sides, vertices and orientation.
averages: Use small data sets for mean, median, mode, range and reverse questions.
factors: Choose factors and multiples; add prime factorisation for Grade 6.
volume: Choose cuboid volume and missing-dimension activities; omit advanced prisms.
circles: Select radius, diameter and circumference; the pack does not require circle area.
scale: Choose simple map scales and actual-length problems.
speed: Use time and speed-unit conversions. Distance–time–speed formula problems remain on the paper.
similar: Choose matching corresponding lengths and simple scale factors.
Show that a reflection or rotation preserves congruence.
stem-leaf: Practise summaries of the same small data sets. Stem-and-leaf construction remains in the pack.
fraction-decimal-percent: Select fraction, decimal and percentage conversion activities.
